prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: one transparent PNG illustration for a children's English "morning / good" word card, displayed around 130 by 110 CSS pixels.

Input images:
- Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, a deterministic rasterization of the existing morning.svg icon. Preserve the clear theme of a warm low rising sun with a small pale teal horizon, but redraw it as a refined children's storybook miniature rather than primitive geometric icon strokes.
- Image 2 is the PRIMARY STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match this exact visual world: warm dark-brown hand-drawn contours, softly textured paper-like watercolor/gouache fills, restrained dimensional shading, warm gentle light and a friendly children's picture-book feel. Do not copy its characters, classroom, framing, white border or text.

Primary request: a low warm golden sun rising just above a soft pale teal-green distant horizon or cloud edge, with a few small cream-colored clouds, a few short gentle golden rays and soft early-morning light. Keep the sunrise silhouette exceptionally clear and simple at small size. The lower sun is naturally hidden behind the pale teal curved horizon/cloud edge. Use gentle organic hand-drawn shapes and warm brown outlines consistent with the supplied picture-book reference. The visible golden sun has subtle paper texture and gentle color variation, not a face. Keep the palette to warm gold, soft cream, pale teal-green and warm dark brown.
Composition: one compact centered standalone illustration on a transparent landscape canvas, approximately 13:11 aspect ratio. Subject occupies about 82–84% of the canvas width, with at least 8% transparent safe margin on every side; all rays, clouds and horizon edges are complete and inside the image. A softly curved, contained horizon/cloud edge is part of the miniature illustration, not a scene-filling landscape or rectangular backdrop.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha outside the contained sun/cloud/horizon illustration, including between the separated rays. No white or colored rectangular background, no baked-in checkerboard, no frame or white sticker outline. Soft morning illumination belongs inside the colored illustration; avoid a large glow that fills the transparent canvas.
Constraints: no face, eyes, smile, text, letters, numbers, logos, symbols, people, animals, buildings, trees, border, white halo or watermark. No 3D plastic, photorealism, vector-flat geometric icon appearance, busy scenery or unrelated decorative objects. Match the reference's gentle hand-drawn storybook craftsmanship.
